title: Review of membrane_evo L7[L3] (SIBDH): the up-vs-twin sweep replicates on seed 21 (K2 share 0.93 vs 0.46), but it is carried by a few giant bodies and jumps with whole-body flips; Weak
summary: After the up and twin packs, I re-ran membrane_evo_up and its identical-event twin membrane_evo on seed 21 (160 frames x 250 steps, t=40000). Walled cells form from noise. The first K2 cell appears by an imposed whole-cell flip at t~19000 and grows into large, irregular bodies that cover much of the domain by t~29500 (sheet). At t~33000 the largest K2 body flips back to K1 in one event (K2 biomass share 0.46 -> 0.07), K2 re-arises, and by t=40000 the share is 0.93 against 0.455 in the twin (k2share.txt). Imposed death disks cut bodies at t~31250 and 40000. labkit: up arm 11 persistent splits, generation 3, merges 11 of 45 splits; L ring rim/core 1.47 (49/70 membrane-like), twin 1.51.

observations.S: rerun_up/sheet.png t=0: noisy phi and catalyst everywhere; cells by t~1750
observations.H: k2share.txt: final K2 share 0.93 (up) vs 0.455 (twin) on seed 21, the claimed direction, but the trajectory runs 0.12, 0.46, 0.07, 0.93 because single whole-body flips of the largest body move the share by ~0.4

seeds_run.result: direction replicates (0.93 vs 0.46); carried by 1-3 giant bodies

not_checked: B (L ring 1.47 up, 1.51 twin: at the threshold, not judged)
verdicts.limitation: One seed. The share is a biomass share dominated by 1-3 large K2 bodies that keep growing and sprawling rather than a population of comparable cells, and imposed whole-body flips (both directions) and imposed death disks move it in jumps, so births and deaths of individuals were not separated from the imposed events. I support S, I and D on this seed; H stays Weak: the direction replicates, but it rests on a few bodies and imposed events.
